item.name: Observe per-sector progress and return sectors to celebrate

request.name: Observe per-sector progress and return sectors to celebrate

description.content:
Single endpoint driving the brain unlock celebration lifecycle.

The FE POSTs the current per-sector "above threshold?" map on
every progress change. The BE compares each sector against the
stored row in ``BrainSectorUnlockSeen`` and returns the list of
sectors whose modal should now fire:

- **No row exists yet** — first observation of this sector for
  this user. Create the row with ``resolved`` set to the current
  ``above_threshold``. If above on first observation we suppress
  the modal (resolved=True), because we have no way to know
  whether the buyer just crossed or has been above for months.
  No celebration in either case.
- **Existing row, resolved=True** — done. Either we celebrated
  previously or we suppressed on first observation. Skip.
- **Existing row, resolved=False, above_threshold=True** — the
  buyer was observed below threshold last time and is now above.
  THIS is the real crossing. Flip ``resolved`` to True and
  return the sector in ``celebrate``.
- **Existing row, resolved=False, above_threshold=False** —
  still below. No state change.

The whole thing runs in a savepoint so the unique-constraint
race (two concurrent POSTs trying to create the same row)
fails cleanly and we re-read the row on the second attempt.
